entries.en: The hell is this? He ain't havin' no attack.

entries.en: Leave her alone! Jotaro's got her tonight!

entries.en: Hahaha – of course! Don't scratch the fuckin' merchandise!
entries.ro: Hahaha – sigur! Nu zgâria marfa aia, dracu' s-o ia!

entries.en: Got a whole night of adventure ahead of you, sweetie! Hahaha!
entries.ro: Te așteaptă o noapte întreagă de aventură, scumpo! Hahaha!
